competitors.what_they_have: The one to beat. Dated 2026 (modified 2026-10-09, '2026年版' in the title). Opens with a summary box (この記事の要点). Has a 7-row table showing by job type whether an ABN is needed (cafe, student, freelance, Uber/DiDi, Uber Eats). Has an employee vs contractor section, the 2026 minimum wage and Payday Super, ABN vs GST with Uber driving kept separate from delivery, 'free on the official site' with a 4-step application, a 'what to do after you get it' section, and a 3-question FAQ (below minimum wage, 6-month rule, tax and super). Inline links to ABR, ATO, Fair Work, Home Affairs and business.gov.au, plus a 監修 credit. No FAQ schema.

Updated 2026-08-17. Gives the 11 digits, about 10 minutes, free, delivery GST at 75,000 and rideshare GST from the first dollar. Has an ABN vs TFN comparison table (3 rows), a 3-step application, a 'managing your own tax' section, a 4-question expandable FAQ (cost, Uber Eats/HungryPanda, cafe/farm, tax), and a sources section with ABR and ATO links.

A 5-step screenshot walkthrough of the ABR form, a checklist of what you need, an 'after registration' list and a 3-question FAQ (cost, TFN needed?, wrong application). Dated 2025, weak on tax and with no official sources apart from abr.gov.au.
A '10分で完了' guide built on 14 screenshots. It is about the procedure only.

A 2019 column by a CPA on ABN income in the tax return: no withholding, one return together with wages, the small business offset, non-commercial losses, and cancelling an ABN you no longer need. Old, with no tables and no GST.

gap_summary: Every top result answers three things in its first screen that our page never states: what an ABN is (11 digits), that registration is free through the government ABR, and whether a working holiday maker needs one for each kind of job. Our page jumps straight to the tax-return consequences. It has no key-figures block, no table by job type, no 47% no-ABN withholding, no ATO rule that super still applies when a contract is mainly for labour, no date, no official source names, and no 'what you need to apply' list. Our page is the only one that combines the sham-contracting warning, the tax-return split and a human next step. Keep that, but put it after the direct answers.

changes.new_text:
Q1 ワーキングホリデービザでもABNは取れますか？
A1 取れます。ABRが示す資格の基準は、オーストラリアで事業を行っている、または始めようとしているかどうかです。ただし雇用されて行う仕事にABNを使う資格はなく、雇用主が雇用の条件としてABNを求めるべきでもありません。

Q2 ABNの登録にお金はかかりますか？
A2 政府のABR（オーストラリア事業者登録簿）を通せば無料です。問題がなければ申請を終えた時点で11桁の番号が発行され、確認に回った場合はABRが20営業日以内の審査を目標にしています。

Q3 ABNを持たずに請負で働くと、どうなりますか？
A3 請求書にABNがないと、支払う側は原則として報酬の47%を源泉徴収します。差し引かれた分はタックスリターンで精算されますが、それまで手元のお金が大きく減ります。

Q4 ABNで働くと、スーパーはもらえなくなりますか？
A4 必ずしもそうではありません。ATOは、主に労働の対価として支払われる請負契約なら、ABNがあってもスーパーの対象として被雇用者扱いになるとしています。スーパーの受け取りについては<Link href="/ja/superannuation">帰国後のスーパー受け取り</Link>をご覧ください。（schema用のanswer文字列にはリンク文言のみを入れ、URLはvisible側のみ）
changes.why: These are the four questions competitors answer and we do not: eligibility, cost, the 47% withholding and super. Each answer is self-contained and under 120 characters for answer engines to quote. Q4 adds the natural link to the super service. FAQPage stays matched because faqLd maps FAQS. If Accordion renders plain strings, put the super link as plain text plus a separate link row, and keep the visible and schema text identical.

changes.why: The EN source states the same unsupported 'matched against it' rule. Flagged so that the languages stay aligned.

facts.fact: An ABN is a unique 11-digit number; it is free to register for an ABN through the Australian Business Register; you need your business structure, proof of identity and details of business activities; an ABN does not replace a TFN; reviews can take 20 business days.

Successful applications receive the 11-digit ABN immediately; with a reference number, ABR aims to review within 20 business days; the application is processed faster if you can be identified with a tax file number (TFN is not stated as mandatory).

Entitled if carrying on or starting an enterprise in Australia; you are not entitled to an ABN for work you carry out as an employee; an employer shouldn't ask you to get an ABN as a condition of employment.
Ride-sourcing drivers must have an ABN and be registered for GST regardless of how much they earn, and must be registered before their first trip.
A payer must withhold 47% from a payment for a supply where the supplier does not quote an ABN (unless an exception such as a hobby applies).
Contractors paid mainly (more than half the contract value) for their labour are employees for super guarantee purposes, even if they have an ABN.

Sham contracting: an employee incorrectly told they are a contractor; the Fair Work example includes being told to get an ABN and invoice while working under direction, with tools supplied and set hours.
